newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids firm.

text.p: Dark Northern Spring wheat bids firmed on Friday and movement picked up slightly in parts of Montana where cash grain dealers reported increased demand for high protein.
"Nearby basis is up for higher protein," a dealer said. "We're seeing some mill demand for 14 and 15 percent high protein milling quality wheat."

The dealer said the increase in basis attracted some farmer selling interest. He noted harvest was one month away and some farmers who still had old crop supplies on farm needed to make room in the bins for the new crop.
Bids were up nine to 20 cents a bushel in Montana.
But prices slipped in eastern North Dakota where excessive moisture has caused crop damage. Rains fell again early Friday, one dealer said.
"It's not looking good," the dealer said. "There's an awful lot of areas that have been wet so long they're looking brown. It's hard to know the extent of the damage until harvest."
